[[Auri's Wand]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Auri the Skull Wand]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Kinya Province]].

==Stats==
:[[Lightning damage]]: 7-11 (Requires 5 [[Air Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Air Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:Halves skill recharge time of [[Air Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as there are no crafter or collector wands that deal 7-11 damage.

Except for the visual appearance, a [[perfect]] technical version for this item is the [[Air Wand]] from crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]].

Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create a perfect technical version of this item with:
*One of the following [[Water Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Destroyer Scepter]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Aptitude not Attitude]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Water Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Air Wand]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Aptitude not Attitude]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
*The Air Magic version of [[Droknar's Scepter]] is a perfect counterpart to this item.
